headlines.title: Ted Cruz says ‘there will be a time’ to make a decision on a 2028 run for president
headlines.description: Sen. Ted Cruz (R-Texas) tells Meet the Press he plans to be on the road “nonstop” heading into the midterms and says “there’s a time for every season” when asked if he’s considering a run for president in 2028.

headlines.title: Jim Clyburn calls to expand the Supreme Court to ‘a baker’s dozen’
headlines.description: Rep. James Clyburn (D-S.C.) tells Meet the Press Congress should expand the Supreme Court to 13 justices “who will follow the constitutional underpinnings” of America.

headlines.title: Rescue Efforts Intensify After Catastrophic Mudslide in Nepal
headlines.description: The search for survivors of the devastating flash flood in Nepal is intensifying in a race against time. The death toll has reached 750 and 2,500 people are officially missing five days after the disaster. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: NBC Crew, Palestinian Woman Attacked by Masked Israeli Settlers
headlines.description: NBC’s Matt Bradley joins Sunday TODAY’s Willie Geist to share an update after he, along with members of our news crew and a Palestinian woman, were attacked by settlers in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu accused the settlers of breaking the law and damaging Israel’s standing the world. Warning: The incident was disturbing.

headlines.title: NASA launches its next-generation space telescope
headlines.description: NASA launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope into space and is expected to survey hundreds of millions of stars and billions of galaxies.

headlines.title: Minnesota Supreme Court rejects Mike Lindell’s bid to recount GOP primary
headlines.description: MyPillow founder Mike Lindell has long denied Donald Trump’s loss in the 2020 presidential election.

headlines.title: Iran’s supreme leader urges Gulf rulers to confront ‘real enemy’ in written message
headlines.description: Iran’s Supreme Leader ​Mojtaba Khamenei urged Muslim countries, particularly those in the Gulf, to unite against what he called their “real enemy” and said divisions among Muslims served the interests of their adversaries.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: College football player dies after collapsing on sidelines moments after scoring touchdown
headlines.description: A running back for William Jewell College in Missouri died Saturday after suffering a medical emergency during the first quarter of his team’s season opener, shortly after scoring a touchdown.

headlines.title: Rep. Jim Clyburn says impeaching Trump shouldn’t be Democrats’ priority if they win back the House
headlines.description: Rep. Jim Clyburn, D-S.C., said that Democrats should not prioritize impeaching President Donald Trump if they win control of the House in the upcoming midterm elections, but instead should focus on making life more affordable

headlines.title: Chicago mass shooting leaves 1 dead, 9 injured Saturday night
headlines.description: Chicago police are investigating a mass shooting on the city’s South Side, with one person dead and at least nine others injured.

headlines.title: Sen. Ted Cruz calls for elections in Venezuela to proceed ‘rapidly’
headlines.description: Sen. Ted Cruz renewed calls for free and fair elections to be held in Venezuela, just two days after Trump announced that the U.S. would take of 65 billion barrels of oil
